input_fields.name: feature_description
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `effect`, `required_geometry`, `required_topology`, and `acceptance_conditions` for one feature effect.

input_fields.name: target_environment
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `host`, `spaceclaim_release`, `api_version`, and `runtime`; other constraints remain explicit members.

input_fields.name: available_methods
input_fields.description: Array of method objects, each with required keys `method_id`, `scope`, `prerequisites`, `target_environments`, `evidence`, and `stability`.

result_fields.name: construction_decision
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `method_id`, `reason`, `prerequisites`, `covered_effect`, and `stability_basis`; nullable when the common output envelope records materially missing requirements.

result_fields.name: alternative_conditions
result_fields.description: Array of alternative objects, each with required keys `method_id`, `when_preferred`, and `tradeoff`; it may be empty.

procedure: Reduce the request to one feature effect and list the geometry, topology, environment, and acceptance conditions it requires.
Filter only the supplied methods whose prerequisites and target-environment constraints are satisfied.
Select one primary method when it covers the effect; when several supplied methods are viable, prefer the simpler stable method and record why.
Return `construction_decision` and any alternative conditions as action data, using the common output envelope only when geometry or environment facts are materially insufficient.
rejection_rules: Reject a whole-part, multi-feature, or ordered recipe request; choose a method for one feature effect only.
Reject any method not present in the supplied method set and do not invent an API or construction primitive.
When viable methods tie, do not mark the action unresolved solely because of the tie; choose the simpler stable supplied method and explain the choice.
Use the common unresolved envelope only when missing geometry or environment facts could change coverage or method validity.
